reviews.text:
I visited the clinic for a neutering surgery. The doctor took the time to explain the pros and cons, drawing diagrams and showing data to help me understand, and then performed examinations. A follow-up examination was conducted on a separate day before the surgery. After the surgery, my dog ​​had trouble urinating, and when I called to inquire, they explained everything carefully, which put my mind at ease. When it was time for the stitches to be removed, my dog ​​seemed happy to be at the hospital, wagging his tail excitedly. The doctor smiled and petted him, and the reception staff and other doctors were all kind and courteous. The price was also very reasonable.

I look forward to continuing to use their services in the future.
He is a very skilled veterinarian.
I traveled all the way from Kanagawa Prefecture to consult about my patella. Despite his busy schedule, Vice Director Mizuno took the time to explain everything to me thoroughly. Thank you very much.

A doctor obsessed with tests → referred patients to a branch clinic and had them undergo the same tests all over again. He didn't even transfer medical records, double-charging from the start. This doctor loved tests for profit and had them done every month, but the illnesses were completely off the mark. No treatment was given → two animals died within a year.

I had been to another hospital, but they weren't specialists, so I was worried. Therefore, I came here hoping to see an orthopedic surgeon. Even though it was my first visit, they listened to my history and symptoms more carefully than I'd ever experienced before, and gave me a thorough examination. I'm truly grateful to the head doctor, and I left feeling relieved.

Although it's a bit of a distance from my home, this is a hospital I would definitely like to visit again if I have any further orthopedic issues.

My beloved corgi had shoulder joint problems, and although it's far from my home, a friend recommended this clinic, so I took him in for a checkup.

They explained everything clearly using a bone model, and although I was anxious, I was able to decide to go ahead with the surgery, entrusting him to Dr. Arai.

It was a difficult shoulder joint surgery, but I'm grateful that Dr. Arai and three other veterinarians were involved.

After the surgery, commuting from afar was tough, but seeing my beloved dog walking happily makes me so glad I chose Dr. Arai for the surgery.

He's still in rehabilitation, so we'll continue to rely on them, but I feel reassured knowing that they answer my concerns over the phone.

If your dog is having trouble with their legs,

I highly recommend Kawase Veterinary Hospital, which has orthopedic specialists (*^^*)

We have been under the care of the associate director since our dog fractured its leg. Because our dog was still a puppy at the time of the fracture, surgery was urgently needed. Despite being off duty, he came in the next day to see us. It was a great help, as there are very few canine orthopedic specialists in our neighborhood. He is highly skilled and provides thorough explanations. Seeing him interact with dogs, you can tell he truly loves them. He is a very trustworthy veterinarian.

We received care here during the final stages of our dog's life. Dr. Matsumoto treated us kindly until the very end, and we were able to be with our beloved dog at home. Thank you very much. We would like to use your services again if the opportunity arises.
